title: Cockpit Active Work Reconciliation
summary: PLAN Lite bounded routine round: reconcile the generated Current Truth Snapshot so operationally complete legacy Work and phase-less containers stay out of Active Work, while a blocked Phase on the primary executable Work becomes the current blocker. The round is inline, Project Control-only, and uses focused snapshot tests plus one full gate with no new Markdown or Evidence artifact.
expectedOutput: The generated Cockpit lists only executable Work with unfinished Phase or Checklist obligations, surfaces the primary Work's blocked Phase, preserves the accepted absence of live cross-repository E2E proof, and leaves product repositories and product/map truth unchanged.
riskSummary: Risk Tier routine. The read-model rule relies on Phase and Checklist state as the executable-work boundary; legacy containers without Phase are excluded rather than rewritten. Stop on schema conflict, accidental product truth promotion, or a snapshot result that hides unfinished executable Work.
